notes.title: Various enhancements
notes.content:
We've just added some enhancements to Remy Raccoon and the Lost Temple - Halloween Hijinks (Volume 1)...



[u]Windowed mode[/u]

Toggle between fullscreen and windowed mode using ESC.



[u]Steam achievements[/u]

There are now 22 achievements to collect :

[b]Skull of Prosperity - Bronze[/b]
- Collect 250 gems

[b]Skull of Prosperity - Silver[/b]
- Collect 500 gems

[b]Skull of Prosperity - Gold[/b]
- Collect 1,000 gems

[b]Skull of Vitality - Bronze[/b]
- Complete 3 consecutive levels without dying

[b]Skull of Vitality - Silver[/b]
- Complete 5 consecutive levels without dying

[b]Skull of Vitality - Gold[/b]
- Complete 7 consecutive levels without dying

[b]Skull of Fate - Bronze[/b]
- Complete 5 consecutive random levels

[b]Skull of Fate - Silver[/b]
- Complete 10 consecutive random levels

[b]Skull of Fate - Gold[/b]
- Complete 15 consecutive random levels

[b]Skull of Enlightenment - Bronze[/b]
- Find 1 hidden rune

[b]Skull of Enlightenment - Silver[/b]
- Find 3 hidden runes

[b]Skull of Enlightenment - Gold[/b]
- Find 5 hidden runes

[b]Skull of Fortitude - Bronze[/b]
- Attempt 10 levels

[b]Skull of Fortitude - Silver[/b]
- Attempt 20 levels

[b]Skull of Fortitude - Gold[/b]
- Attempt 30 levels

[b]Skull of Discovery - Bronze[/b]
- Complete level 3

[b]Skull of Discovery - Silver[/b]
- Complete level 5

[b]Skull of Discovery - Gold[/b]
- Complete level 10

[b]Skull of Endurance - Bronze[/b]
- Total of survival mode high scores - 150 gems

[b]Skull of Endurance - Silver[/b]
- Total of survival mode high scores - 200 gems

[b]Skull of Endurance - Gold[/b]
- Total of survival mode high scores - 250 gems

[b]Skull of Dominion[/b]
- Unlock all other skulls

[b]*** IMPORTANT NOTE ***[/b]

Achievements earned during gameplay will be awarded from the skull page when the relevant skull unlocks.



[u]Pricing[/u]

We've also introduced a permanent price reduction.



Enjoy ːsteamhappyː
